Page 10: Capy, the chill guardian

Visual ground truth for docs/design/pages/mascot.md. Every picture is a headless Rive CLI render of the RML (docs/design/mascot/styles/expressions/scene.rml, generated by gen_s1v2.py): what you see is the art that gets rigged. Style S1 Sticker, round 2. Eye rule (yours): chilling = curved-line eyes, doing something = round eyes, intense = focused.

At 40 dp the eye is about 3 px, so the props (z, sweat drop, sparkles) and the motion carry the mood there. Moods switch by fading face parts over 150 ms; the silhouette never changes.
S3

The yuzu bath: offline banner (E1, idea I1)

Real capybaras soak in yuzu baths in Japanese zoos every winter. Here each message waiting to send is a yuzu in the pool. Mirrored so it faces the text.

You're offline — messages will send when you're back.3 waitingRetry

1 · offline, 3 queued, chill eyes

Back online, sending 2…

2 · online, active eyes, one yuzu leaves per real send

Back online, sending 1…

3 · flush

All sent.

4 · happy + hop, then the banner collapses (or 10 s after reconnecting)

You're offline — messages will send when you're back.3 waitingRetry
Back online, sending 2…
Back online, sending 1…
All sent.
A tap on the capybara pets it (happy face, light haptic) and does not trigger Retry. With 4 or more waiting, the pool shows 3 yuzus and the line says the real number. "All sent." is shown only during the hop, then the banner leaves.

View model Capy

mood chill · active · happy · sleepy · worried · focused   pose none · pet · celebrate · guard   still   reducedMotion   pet▸   holding   hop▸   wave▸   celebrate▸   lookX −1…1   queued 0…3   flush▸   (▸ = trigger)

State machine layers

Idle breathe 3.4 s; blink about every 4.6 s only while the eyes are round (curved eyes get a slow content squeeze instead) · Mood face sets, 150 ms fades · Action pet, hop, wave, celebrate, flush · Props z loop, sweat bob, steam.

Budget: one .riv ≤ 60 KB, no blur, at most one clip per artboard. One Capy Flutter widget loads it once; still placements park the Idle layer.

Right PIN: the lock leaves at once, exactly as today (app-lock E4), so there is no unlock hop (decision 2). Fingerprint, Forgot PIN and the lockout timer are untouched; the capybara only reads the digit count and the wrong-PIN result.

Decision 1: why Front, not Head

A profile head can only nod up and down, so "following the dots" reads as a nod. The Front view slides its whole face left and right (±10 in the rig, up from ±6) and already holds the key.

The envelopes keep pace with the real download: one at most every 1.6 s, and only when the chat or message count moved since the last one. A stalled download = a waiting capybara. One envelope is a pace, not one message; the numbers stay in the card. A wrong key closes the screen exactly as today.

Stickers

J3: the Stickers sheet, 4 × 72 dp. A tap sends and closes it. Tiles read "Send sticker: Hi".

Sticker: on-my-way
Sticker: lol

J2.3: an old app (before phase 4) shows each sticker as this text line; its chat list says "New message".

The sticker id rides inside the encrypted text (Sticker: hi); the server sees only type = sticker. Nothing uploads, so a sticker sent offline waits in the outbox like a text and the bath banner counts it. The server change is decided by a read-only check first (J4 W0), with your yes.

Phase 5: looks, app-bar buddy, failed-send sheet, About, app icon (spec §K, PASS 2026-11-12)

Headless renders of the rig with R11 (looks), made by docs/design/mascot/phase5/apply_phase5.py → render.sh, on the light and dark page colours. Ships in two commits: 5a looks + C1 + C5 + S1, 5b the icon you pick. Onboarding and the Loaf view are parked (K5).

I4 · night and festival looks, every view (K1)

Hats are drawn once and placed into each view as nested artboards: capy.riv goes 56.6 → 63.7 KB (drawn into each view: 69.6 KB). 13.9 KB of every published file is the Free-plan watermark. That breaks the 60 KB budget: decision 1 raises it to 64 KB. Dates: Diwali and Holi from a table to 2030, re-checked against the panchang at build.

D7 · launcher icon options from Front and Sit (K6, decision 8): design · circle · squircle · small · themed light · themed dark

Rows, two each (light and dark wallpaper): A Front on bath teal (default), B Front on cream, C Sit on bath teal, D Sit on cream. The red ring in the first column is the 66 dp safe zone. Themed = Android 13 monochrome layer (line art).

Today the launcher icon is still Flutter's default. The chosen icon also becomes AppLogoTile, so on the M52 a cold start goes icon → the same picture in the Flutter splash, with no lock tile in between (decision 9).
